name: QQ Study Router
description: Route QQBot messages to learning specialist agents and supervise local project progress from OpenClaw/mobile.

embeddingProvider.description: Provider ID for embedding API calls

semanticThreshold.description: Minimum cosine similarity for confident semantic routing (0-1)

semanticMargin.description: Minimum score gap between best and second-best route for confident semantic routing (0-1)

classifierModel.description: Model for LLM classifier fallback when semantic confidence is low

classifierProvider.description: Provider ID for classifier LLM calls

enableCascade.description: Enable cascade escalation from specialists to deep-expert via ESCALATE signal

contextWindowSize.description: Number of recent turns to include when routing follow-up messages

workspaceDir.description: Workspace directory shared by the learning agents

embeddingCacheFile.description: Optional path for the semantic route embedding cache

projectSupervisor.description: Local project progress supervisor and mobile dashboard settings

token.description: Optional fixed dashboard token. If omitted, one is generated in state.

autoStartServer.description: Start the local dashboard when the plugin starts

staleAfterMs.description: Mark project blocked when no file activity is seen after this window

maxFiles.description: Maximum files to scan per pass

watchedPorts.description: Local ports expected to be open while the project is running

logFiles.description: Project-relative log files to tail in the dashboard

ignoreDirs.description: Additional directory names to skip during scans

allowedCommands.description: Named shell commands that may be started from mobile
